newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES END LOWER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES END LOWER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Eleven stocks fell, four rose and six were flat in 22.4-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday, with only Zywiec not trading.
NFI units rose 0.3 percent to 168.5 zlotys in 77.6-million-zloty trade.
The WIG 20 index rose 1.2 percent to 1,779.0 points, due to 17 stocks rising and four falling in comparison with Friday's main-market fixing.
